results.title: Hunting Jessica Brok
results.overview: Long before she was a single mother in a sleepy South African town, Jessica Brok was a highly skilled, coldblooded, special ops assassin. She thought she’d left that life behind. She thought her last ill-fated mission was her last. She thought wrong.

results.title: Dante's Inferni
results.overview: The Infernal journey through the first part of the afterlife, Hell, begins in a dark forest where Dante is threatened by three wild beasts. He's rescued by his hero Virgil at Beatrice's request. Virgil guides and protects Dante on his dark journey descending circle-by-circle and their subdivisions to the center of the Earth where Lucifer resides, and out into Purgatory.

results.title: The Pet Detective
results.overview: A couple of amateur sleuths attempt to solve the mystery behind disappearing pets, but become embroiled in far more sinister crimes.

results.title: Dead Bride
results.overview: After her father’s death, Alyson, her partner Richard and their baby return to her childhood home. Following a few shocking supernatural events, Alyson discovers that she and her family have been living with a terrible curse, unleashed in the past by a bride killed by Alyson’s grandfather. Soon after Alyson’s child disappears and she has no choice but to embark on a frightening journey into the underworld, to free herself from the bride’s curse and to look for her daughter.

results.title: Fat
results.overview: Havva decides to finish her deceased mother's art exhibition after being betrayed by her lover. To fulfill her mother's final wish, Havva must fit into her mother's wedding dress—which requires losing 45 kg.

results.title: Doñana - Spain's Garden of Eden
results.overview: DOÑANA is a breathtaking portrait of one of Europe’s last true wildernesses. Located in southern Spain, the Coto de Doñana National Park is not only the continent’s largest ecological reserve – it is also a critical resting point for over 300 migratory bird species and a sanctuary for endangered animals such as the Iberian lynx and the white-headed duck.

results.title: The Golden Spurtle
results.overview: In a quaint Scottish village in the Highlands, contenders from around the globe gather to compete for the title of World Porridge Champion armed only with oats, salt and water. As the ailing Porridge Chieftain's tenure ends, he embarks on a mission to find a successor. Amidst intense rivalries and the charm of eccentric locals, this documentary delves into the legacy of the village and unveils a captivating culinary spectacle.

results.title: Trevlig nyårshelg!
results.overview: It's time to celebrate New Year's Eve with all the beloved characters in Happy Weekend! We meet Anton and Linus, among others, who wish for completely different things from the coming year. Gunnar celebrates in a way that is both exaggerated and unexpected, while Yvonne gathers Tom's "friends" for a grand dinner - just like every year. In addition, Präst-Björn offers a sparkling New Year's show!

results.title: SOS jeunesse en détresse
results.overview: Today in France, one in five young people suffers from severe depressive symptoms, and the number of minors visiting psychiatric emergency rooms has tripled in the last five years. Despite the political will that has been demonstrated, child psychiatry is nevertheless faced with a severe lack of resources. The interminable waiting times for treatment are causing a surge in prescriptions for psychotropic drugs.

results.title: Capel Green
results.overview: A retrospective of the Rendlesham UFO incident.

results.title: Francesco Cavalli : Pompeo Magno  @ Bayreuth Baroque 2025
results.original_title: Francesco Cavalli : Pompeo Magno Bayreuth Baroque 2025
results.overview: Francesco Cavalli's incandescent opera, where tragedy rubs shoulders with comedy, and burlesque alternates with deep emotion. Max Emanuel Cenčić directs a lively production, drawing on the codes of commedia dell'arte. This game of love and chance combines passion, betrayal, and power struggles.  The countertenor takes on the title role, while Leonardo García Alarcón conducts the Cappella Mediterranea.

results.title: City of the Sun. Leonidov
results.overview: A film about the life and work of the "paper architect" Ivan Leonidov.

results.title: Vital Signs
results.overview: In one of his finest dramatic performances yet, Louis Koo stars as a veteran ambulanceman who simply wants to do his job without any interference from his boss. While he considers emigrating with his daughter, he clashes with his new partner, a young go-getter on the fast-track up the bureaucratic ladder. A mature directorial effort by Cheuk Wan-chi, this dramedy about Hong Kong’s civil service culture and the latest emigration wave is a charming,  yet sobering love letter to her city and its people, especially those who still remain.

results.title: Emerging
results.overview: When Jackie's depression and drug use get out of hand, she's sent to live at a group therapy and rehabilitation house for 5 weeks. Once there, she has to navigate not only her own issues, but the problems of her fellow patients

results.title: NJPW x Stardom Historic X-over in Guangzhou
results.original_title: 中国・広州「Historic X-over NJPW×STARDOM in Guangzhou」
results.overview: NJPW x Stardom Historic X-over in Guangzhou was a professional wrestling event co-promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and World Wonder Ring Stardom, which also featured wrestlers from China’s own INFIN Wrestling. It took place on October 5, 2025, at Damai 66 Livehouse in Guangzhou, China, and was headlined by Cosmic Angels (Natsupoi, Saori Anou and Sayaka Kurara) against H.A.T.E (Natsuko Tora, Ruaka and Rina).

results.title: The Sample
results.overview: A man wakes up on the side of the road with no memories, and a key. The key leads him to a destroyed laboratory where he begins to piece together what happened, and face the results of the failed experiments.

results.title: Deuce
results.overview: A friendship is threatened by an unexpected culprit: baseball practice.

results.title: Blues
results.overview: Karthi, a disgruntled assistant on commercial productions, is working on an honest, personal film script, but his project is without industry backers. In the dispiriting pursuit of his dream, he loses his love and sinks into alcoholism, until he meets a kindred spirit adrift in the world.
